description: Answers whether Meta Lead Ads is connected natively, and once signed in, grant (the Facebook permissions granted, declined and missing, and the Page ids the person picked; no token): the connected Pages (needsReconnect true means Facebook refused that Page and its leads wait until it is connected again), connectUrl (the Connections page where your user presses Connect Meta and signs in with Facebook in their own browser; an agent cannot do that step), and, once signed in, connectablePages to pass to connect_facebook_page. Changes nothing. Pass an idempotency_key.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: meta_leads_status
title: Meta Lead Ads connection
